name: Urosk Weather Indicator
description: Multi-model weather forecast in the top bar. Shows the median of six Open-Meteo models (ICON-D2, ICON-EU, ECMWF, GFS, Météo-France, UKMO) with their range and warns when the models disagree. The menu has current conditions, a 7-day list, hourly charts and the forecast of each model. Moon phase, moonrise and moonset computed locally. Several searchable locations, metric or imperial units, and optional river gauges: modelled discharge anywhere in the world (GloFAS) or live gauges in Slovenia (ARSO).
